reader_summary.headline: 20 years ago, our reality today would have seemed unimaginable.
reader_summary.overview: 20 years ago, our reality today would have seemed unimaginable. From the ability to work from anywhere, to computers that fit your pocket. And today, all of that is just the status quo. Looking ahead, we've barely scratched a surface of what's possible, with new technologies like reusable rockets, large-scale AI models, new kinds of communities and cities.

key_points.text: From the ability to work from anywhere, to computers that fit your pocket.
key_points.evidence_quote: From the ability to work from anywhere, to computers that fit your pocket, to the cost of sequencing the entire human genome for less than that same pocket computer.

key_points.text: Looking ahead, we've barely scratched a surface of what's possible, with new technologies like reusable rockets, large-scale AI models.
key_points.evidence_quote: Looking ahead, we've barely scratched a surface of what's possible, with new technologies like reusable rockets, large-scale AI models, new kinds of communities and cities, and so much more.

key_points.text: So we continue to go through the cycle of science fiction to science reality.
key_points.evidence_quote: So we continue to go through the cycle of science fiction to science reality.

key_points.text: And unlike the memes, our reality often outperforms our expectations.
